curated-fs-kalam-gf-afacad: Kalam feels hand-drawn and cozy, its lines bundled tight. Afacad, a plain sans bent like glass tubing, suits quick glances, while Kalam earns its keep big and short, say on a pizza shop sign.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-alatsi: Inviting and cozy, Kalam looks hand-drawn, its lines bundled close together. Alatsi, a plain sans, is best sipped at a modest size, a quiet, friendly partner for the hand-drawn headline.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-bbh-hegarty: Hand-drawn and bundled tight, Kalam feels cozy, the sort of thing you might see on a fitness studio wordmark. BBH Hegarty stays sparse and modern, a cool counterweight best taken in sips.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Handwritten warmth meets literary weight. Kalam keeps its bundled, hand-drawn lines cozy, while BhuTuka Expanded One, curvy and unclamped, slows the reading to a leisurely walk.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-cabin-condensed: Cabin Condensed sits tight, its letters nearly touching. Beneath Kalam's cozy, hand-drawn heading it stays a slim plain sans of ribbon-like strokes of constant width, suited to light reading.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-gabriela: Gabriela is a text serif, classic and sure of itself. Its strokes vary only slightly in weight, which gives Kalam's cozy handwritten lines a steady partner, though long paragraphs aren't its job.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-gelasio: Gelasio is a serif with a faint, taffy-like swell in each curve. Handwritten coziness against traditional bookishness is the draw here, and it works better kept short, like a letterpress invitation.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-gupter: Kalam's hand-drawn, tightly bundled lines feel cozy, like a note from a hair accessories brand. And Gupter, a tight-tracked serif with gently swelling curves, brings an editorial edge to that warmth, better saved for brief moments.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-hubballi: Tightly crammed and contemporary, this sans-serif body (think a jewelry brand card) sits beneath Kalam's cozy handwriting. Hubballi gives Kalam's looseness something sturdy to lean on, its fat crossbars best kept to brief bursts.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-inknut-antiqua: Dignified and traditional, Inknut Antiqua spaces its letters wide. Beside Kalam's cozy, hand-drawn lines, its restrained curves feel formal, a text serif happiest with just a few quiet lines.
